description: Hewlett-Packard于2003年推出的数码相机。配备Pentax® precision f2.6 to f4.9 (wide), f5.0 to f9.0 (telephoto)。快门速度1/1500 to 2 sec。使用JPEG & MPEG。有效像素3.2。

specs.镜头: Pentax® precision f2.6 to f4.9 (wide), f5.0 to f9.0 (telephoto)
specs.英文简介: The HP PhotoSmart 735 is a 2003 digital camera from Hewlett-Packard, with a 3x optical zoom and a 3.2 megapixel sensor.
